summary: Leg day, so dinner leans into extra carbs with Mary's coconut-braised chicken plus pasta, and lunch stays chicken-forward with Lemon Oregano Roasted Chicken and an added chicken breast. The wellness-bar Ginger Mango Protein Smoothie (today's protein smoothie) fuels a low-fat pre-workout with pita for carbs.

meals.name: Uber Breakfast
meals.note: Turkey and a poppy seed bagel with almond butter and Greek yogurt for protein and carbs, raspberries for fiber.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: Lemon Oregano Roasted Chicken as the main with an extra chicken breast for protein, multigrain bread and whole grain pasta for carbs and fiber.

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Today's wellness-bar protein smoothie plus a whole-wheat pita for low-fat carbs and protein before lifting.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
meals.note: Coconut-braised chicken for a big protein-and-carb main on leg day, extra chicken breast, pasta and black beans to close out protein, carbs and fiber.

items.name: Mary's Free Range Lemongrass, Coconut Braised Chicken
